Energy | Representative Ashley Hinson Skip to main content Energy The continued pursuit of American energy independence is critical to our nation's economy and national security. It is imperative that Congress unleashes America's energy capacity and remove burdensome regulations to lower gas and home energy prices. In Washington, I continue to champion an all-of-the-above domestic energy strategy that includes expanding Iowa’s biofuels. I will continue working to unlock America’s energy potential to create good-paying jobs, support Iowa’s rural economy, and lower costs across the supply chain.  Issues Agriculture and Rural Development Budget and Spending Childcare Defending Life Economy and Jobs Education and Workforce Development Energy Government Oversight and Accountability Improving Health Care Infrastructure and Transportation National Security and Defense Veterans

Veterans | Representative Ashley Hinson Skip to main content Veterans America’s veterans have made tremendous sacrifices to preserve our nation and protect the freedoms we enjoy every day. These brave patriots deserve the highest quality of care and benefits when they return home. I led the Sgt. Ketchum Rural Veterans Mental Health Act which expanded mental health care access to veterans in rural communities which was signed into law. I have also introduced bipartisan legislation to ensure Vietnam veterans can access essential healthcare services and benefits, and bipartisan legislation that eliminates the benefit offset that prevents certain service members from receiving both military retired pay and VA disability compensation in full. I will continue to advocate for reforms at the Department of Veterans Affairs that improve access to benefits and expand care for our nation’s heroes. If you need assistance navigating the VA, please click  here or call my office at (319) 364-2288. Childcare | Representative Ashley Hinson Skip to main content Childcare As a working mother of two children, I understand the importance of accessible child care and am passionate about pursuing policies to make child care more attainable for Iowa’s families. I frequently hear from Iowans who are struggling to find affordable and accessible care for their children, as well as from businesses whose employees are having difficulty finding childcare so that they can come to work. With the passage of the historic Working Families Tax Cuts, I was able to deliver an improved Child and Dependent Care Tax Credit, enhanced Employer-Provided Child Care Credit, and permanently extend and increase the Child Tax Credit to $2,200, that will rise every year in line with inflation. Defending Life | Representative Ashley Hinson Skip to main content Defending Life I am pro-life and pro-family and will remain a strong and consistent voice for mothers and their children. We must protect the unborn and stand up for the sanctity of life. Taxpayer dollars should not fund abortion providers or abortions. This funding should be used to support family planning options and essential women's healthcare services. I will fight to ensure that taxpayer dollars support mothers through community health centers, including those that provide care to women in underserved areas. Being pro-life has always been about more than just ending abortion, it’s about creating a culture of life and supporting all families. Economy and Jobs | Representative Ashley Hinson Skip to main content Economy and Jobs Following President Biden’s disastrous time in office, we must get our economy back on track. To jumpstart our economy, my colleagues and I have passed the Working Families Tax Cuts that permanently extend many key provisions of the 2017 Trump Tax Cuts, supporting Main Street job creators and protecting working families from the largest tax increase in American history. The bill also includes new policies to support hardworking Iowans, such as no tax on tips and no tax on overtime, which will save the average American over $1,300 per year in federal income taxes. I will continue to pursue policies that reduce onerous regulations and incentivize growth for American workers and Iowa’s economy.     Issues Agriculture and Rural Development Budget and Spending Childcare Defending Life Economy and Jobs Education and Workforce Development Energy Government Oversight and Accountability Improving Health Care Infrastructure and Transportation National Security and Defense Veterans

Budget and Spending | Representative Ashley Hinson Skip to main content Budget and Spending With our national debt at a record high, it is imperative Washington rein in spending and take steps to balance the federal budget. The debt incurred today is an added tax burden on Americans tomorrow. While families across the country live within their means, Washington consistently overspends and overextends taxpayer resources. If Iowans can sit at the kitchen table and balance their checkbooks, so can Congress. I understand the value of a dollar and will make the tough decisions needed to push down the national debt, eliminate waste, and balance our country’s books. I will fight to ensure each taxpayer dollar is put to good use and ensure we cut wasteful spending, including funding for Iraqi Sesame Street and “Net Zero Cities” in Mexico. National Security and Defense | Representative Ashley Hinson Skip to main content National Security and Defense The most important responsibility of our federal government is to provide for the common defense of our nation. With a policy of peace through strength, our powerful military deters adversaries and discourages aggression. This strategy requires ensuring our troops always have the resources needed to counter adversaries like China, Russia, and Iran. I will always support the men, women, and their families who sacrifice so much to protect our nation and defend American values across the world. One of our top threats to national security is the Chinese Communist Party (CCP). The CCP continues to rip off Americans by stealing billions worth of intellectual property, engaging in fraudulent trade practices, perpetrating egregious human rights abuses, and taking advantage of the U.S. and our allies without consequence. As a member of the House Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party, I have championed my bipartisan legislation the Protecting American Industry and Labor from International Trade Crimes Act to establish a task force within the U.S. Department of Justice to combat China's trade crimes and protect American workers and manufacturers. I will continue to work with my colleagues to ensure the safety and protection of Americans and curb the CCP’s growing influence.   More on National Security and Defense Image Hinson Effort to Secure Ag Supply Chain Included in Trump Initiative to Combat CCP Threats to American Agriculture & Food Supply July 8, 2025 Press Release Washington, D.C.  — Today, under the leadership of Secretary Brooke Rollins, the Department of Agriculture (USDA) rolled out its national security plan alongside Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, and Attorney General Pam Bondi. Congresswoman Hinson released the following statement on the Trump Administration’s “Make Agriculture Great Again” Initiative, which includes several efforts that the congresswoman has led for years. Agriculture and Rural Development | Representative Ashley Hinson Skip to main content Agriculture and Rural Development Image Agriculture is the backbone of our nation and the heart of Iowa's way of life. Despite hardships such as floods, tornadoes, and derechos, our resilient farmers continue to produce a safe and abundant food supply, and they deserve their efforts to be matched in advocacy. I have introduced legislation to improve flood and drought mitigation   and legislation that will protect the American food and agriculture supply chain from the influence of the Chinese Communist Party. I will continue to advocate for the renewal of the Farm Bill and for other policies that support the agricultural economy and provide farmers with the necessary resources to sustain their operations. As a member of the House Appropriations Committee, I have secured over $100 million in Community Project Funding to support flood mitigation, essential emergency services, childcare facilities, and infrastructure needs in the community. I will continue to advocate for improving rural infrastructure, expanding broadband access, and increasing access to healthcare. Infrastructure and Transportation | Representative Ashley Hinson Skip to main content Infrastructure and Transportation Infrastructure in Iowa and across the country desperately requires upgrades and modernization. Iowans rely on these crumbling roads and bridges to transport children to school, workers to their jobs, products to consumers, and food from farms to tables. By removing regulatory burdens that hinder essential projects and ensuring that taxpayer dollars flow to meaningful infrastructure investments, we can unlock economic growth and enhance workforce development opportunities. Through the appropriations process, I have secured key infrastructure investments for Iowans including for emergency operations facilities, water treatment centers, and upgraded roads.  Issues Agriculture and Rural Development Budget and Spending Childcare Defending Life Economy and Jobs Education and Workforce Development Energy Government Oversight and Accountability Improving Health Care Infrastructure and Transportation National Security and Defense Veterans

Education and Workforce Development | Representative Ashley Hinson Skip to main content Education and Workforce Development The one-size-fits-all nature of the American education system disadvantages our children. It is vital that all children can go to the school that fits their educational needs. Our current system places too much emphasis on standardized testing while overlooking the unique learning behaviors of individual children. By expanding school choice, we will give families and their children the freedom to choose the right educational option regardless of zip code. Moving beyond the classroom, Iowa’s employers struggle to find skilled workers. Fixing this problem begins with workforce development. I will continue to focus on closing the skills gap that holds back our workforce and hinders business growth through a renewed focus on technical education and post-secondary credentials. This will put more Americans to work and keep our 21 st -Century economy competitive and growing. Government Oversight and Accountability | Representative Ashley Hinson Skip to main content Government Oversight and Accountability My commitment to American taxpayers is to protect their hard-earned dollars by rooting out the rampant waste, fraud, and abuse in Washington. I support the Department of Government Efficiency in its mission to shine a light on inappropriate government expenditures that don't serve the American people, like tens of millions of dollars for DEI contracts and Iraqi Sesame Street. By providing accessible and transparent leadership, Americans can "follow the money" and understand where their hard-earned tax dollars are going, thereby restoring trust and promoting government accountability.
